Only two sample drawings exist in this repository. These are copied unchanged from
`sample_images/`. They are NOT real field photographs or labelled PlantVillage
test images. Do not interpret filenames as validated crop/disease labels.

Missing: at least six independent labelled leaf photographs spanning healthy and
diseased crops, plus held-out PlantVillage and field-image splits for entropy
threshold fitting. No extra examples were synthesized or relabelled to claim
accuracy. Tests using controlled logits are explicitly separate mapping tests.
